comparison_rules: Tumor total partition is not normal-brain Kp,uu.
IDH1 or IDH2-R172K potency is not R140Q potency.
Single-dose radioactivity fraction is not steady-state active exposure.
Separate analyte peaks are not synchronized.
Molar predose ratio is not AUC ratio.
Adult oncology PK is not an infant dose or therapeutic window.
Access failure does not prove evidence absence.
